source: pred.gg ranked matches (sampled per hero, <= 200/hero per run; src/ingest/predgg-feed.ts): same-role lane pairs, 2026-11-03 -> 2026-11-10; directed "a|b" = a's record into b, n >= 20
note: EMPIRICAL head-to-head lane records from a per-hero match sample of the current patch. `pairs` / `cells` are all ranks; `pairsByBand` / `cellsByBand` (when present) split each directed record by the rank that player held in the game (low Bronze+Silver, mid Gold+Platinum, high Diamond and up; unplaced players only count in all ranks). Raw cells persist ALL pairs so same-patch reruns resume incrementally from window.to; pairs are the n-gated consumables.

validation.method: sim net kill-window verdict vs field winrate, counted only where both commit (field >=52% or <=48%, sim net != 0)

shrink.note: shrunkWr = empirical-Bayes head-to-head rate: (wins + k*prior) / (games + k). prior = 0.5 + (a lane wr - 0.5) - (b lane wr - 0.5) from the index roleWr in the lane both play most; k fitted from the records' spread around the prior (method of moments, 10..1000). lane = the lane the pair most likely met in (shared role with the most games for the thinner hero); records carry no lane of their own. Counters rank by shrunkWr (src/matchup-edge.ts).
